_note: Low-carbon infrastructure funding & finance levers across Singapore, Bangkok, Hanoi (sourced research 2020-2026). Confidence: VERIFIED = official; PARTIAL = announced/inferred; INDICATIVE = proxy or closed scheme. Powers a city-aware 'how to fund this' view — Singapore instruments already surface on the Act page; Bangkok/Hanoi captured for portability.

singapore.name: Electric Heavy Vehicle Charger Grant (EHVCG)
singapore.terms: 50% of install, up to S$30,000/charger, 500 chargers

singapore.name: SolarNova Programme
singapore.terms: developer builds+owns; agencies buy power via long-term PPA; ~2,200 MWp on 8,400 HDB blocks by 2023

singapore.name: Skyrise Greenery Incentive Scheme (SGIS)
singapore.terms: 50% of install, cap S$200/m² rooftop, S$500/m² vertical

singapore.name: Green Mark Incentive Scheme – Existing Buildings 2.0
singapore.terms: S$25-45/tCO₂ reduced (by Green Mark tier), up to 50% of cost; caps S$0.6-1.2M

singapore.name: Energy Efficiency Grant (EEG)
singapore.terms: up to 70% (SME) / 30% (large), cap S$30k; Advanced up to S$350k for ≥350 tCO₂ lifetime

singapore.name: Carbon Pricing Act (Carbon Tax)
singapore.terms: S$25/t (2024-25) → S$45 (2026-27) → S$50-80 by 2030; up to 5% via international credits

singapore.name: Sustainable Bond & Loan Grant Schemes (SBGS / SLGS)
singapore.terms: bonds up to S$125k issuance cost; loans up to S$125k advisory (≥S$20M, ≥3yr)

bangkok.name: BOI Investment Incentives (EV 3.5)
bangkok.terms: CIT holiday 8-13 yrs + 50% cut 5 yrs; import-duty exemptions; 100% foreign ownership

bangkok.name: Excise Tax on Fuel Carbon Content
T-VER Carbon Credit Scheme
bangkok.terms: tradeable credits; 16.1 MtCO₂e across 298 projects by Aug 2023

bangkok.name: ADB / commercial green loans
bangkok.terms: syndicated A/B loans (e.g. Phu Yen 257MW solar)

bangkok.name: State EV-infrastructure co-investment
bangkok.terms: utility equity + partner cost-sharing; ≥12,000 chargers by 2030

hanoi.name: Power Development Plan 8 (PDP8)
hanoi.terms: sets RE + 3 GW storage by 2030 targets; shapes future auctions

hanoi.name: Direct Power Purchase Agreements (DPPA)
hanoi.terms: corporates buy directly from private RE; bilateral rates

hanoi.name: Green bonds / loans (ADB, VDB)
hanoi.terms: ADB US$186M green loan (Phu Yen); domestic green bonds VND6.9T (2024)

hanoi.name: World Bank Urban Transport / metro finance
hanoi.terms: IDA US$155M + GEF US$9.8M (BRT); ADB 50-yr loans for metro lines

hanoi.name: EV purchase incentives (expired/local)
hanoi.terms: national VND70-150M/EV ended 2022; local pilots continue

hanoi.name: Carbon market (planned)
hanoi.terms: carbon market by 2026 under 2022 Environmental Protection Law
